verdict.rationale: Rollbar's REST API exposes 'much of the data in the system', and the documented item listing supports paging through results, so a user could script an extraction of items. Webhooks can also push data to external services. However, nothing documents a dedicated full-account export, the API is explicitly not described as covering all data, and no open export format is named. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-data export feature, coverage of all data (occurrences, sessions, people, settings), explicitly stated open export formats, migration or offboarding guidance, and independent confirmation that a complete export works.
